tasks.subject: Fix registry.ts to use messages format for AI SDK
tasks.description: Update packages/ai/src/registry.ts to use messages with image content instead of top-level images field.
tasks.output:
Successfully fixed registry.ts to use messages format for AI SDK. Changes made:
1. Fixed template literal syntax error in EXTRACTION_PROMPT (line 26)
2. Updated generateObject call to use messages format with image content instead of top-level images field

From git diff:
- Removed: prompt: EXTRACTION_PROMPT, images: [{ url: imageUrl }]
- Added: messages: [{ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text: EXTRACTION_PROMPT }, { type: "image", image: imageUrl }] }]

The file now correctly uses the AI SDK messages format for passing both text and image content.
